hero.title: Unleashing creativity and passion in every project
hero.body: Welcome to the immersive world of Calcifire Studios, where gaming dreams come true. Join us on an epic adventure filled with excitement, challenges, and endless possibilities.

about.title: Creating Games That Inspire and Entertain
about.body: Calcifire Studios is a game studio founded by university students with a mission to create captivating and innovative games that bring joy to players around the world. We believe in the power of games to inspire and entertain, and we are dedicated to delivering unique and immersive experiences.

project.body1: Winner of HUG JAM 3, 'Hunger' immerses you in the cold and relentless nights of São Paulo. As someone living on the streets, your mission is simple yet brutal: survive.
project.body2: Uncover the secrets of a mind trapped in a psychogenic coma. Here you are the Warrior of consciousness navigating through the subconscious to confront Shadow Creatures and overcome past traumas.
project.body3: Falling in Abyss brings Dante's Inferno to life in a way never seen before, immersing the player in deep reflections, epic battles, and breathtaking landscapes alongside their character, where decisions will directly influence their fate.

team.title: Meet Our Team
team.body: Get to know the talented university students behind Calcifire Studios.
